name: transcript-assistant-message
opens_with: (agent script only — no keystroke opens it)
notes: The transcript is the one surface every other overlay occludes, so it is the ground truth for 'did render_app paint anything'. Catches a regression where render_messages returns early, drops the assistant gutter indent, or the final-render-after-last-key pass at the tail of TuiApp::run_headless stops firing (that pass is what makes the last key's effect visible at all). is_streaming == false proves the Done event terminated the turn rather than the run being force-cut at the frame cap.
